# simplemdm_installed_app (Data Source)

Retrieves a single installed app record by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplemdm_installed_app" "specific" {
  id = "6632"
}

output "version" {
  value = data.simplemdm_installed_app.specific.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Required. Installed app ID.

### Read-Only

- `bundle_size` (Number) Bundle size in bytes.
- `discovered_at` (String)
- `dynamic_size` (Number) Dynamic size in bytes.
- `identifier` (String) Application bundle identifier.
- `last_seen_at` (String)
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the app is managed by SimpleMDM.
- `name` (String) Application name.
- `short_version` (String) Application short version string.
- `version` (String) Application version.
